initial_condition: Empty blue can and transparent cup with its lid closed are visible on the table.
goal: Place the empty blue can bottom-down on the closed transparent cup lid.
constraints: RGB-only object judgment; no calibration, simulator object state or historical motion targets.
One bounded action proposal per observation cycle; preserve execution limits and uncertainty latches.
Model visual claims and independently reviewed outcomes must be reported separately.

steps.goal: Identify the specified objects, initial state and available RGB views; freeze the task variant.
Approach the empty blue can along a visually clear route.
Align the open fingers with a feasible grasp on the empty blue can.
Grasp the empty blue can and verify retention after separation from its support.
Carry the empty blue can, bottom-down toward the closed cup lid while verifying retention.
Visually align the empty blue can, bottom-down over the closed cup lid.
Establish support of the empty blue can, bottom-down on the closed cup lid without pressing.
Release the supported the empty blue can, bottom-down and withdraw the empty gripper.
Verify the empty blue can, bottom-down remains on the closed cup lid in separated views after gripper withdrawal.
